dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer has all of the MBTA Subway Stations in Cambridge.
Purpose: Created in-house by using the building centroid of subway head houses. Used for mapping purposes.

Supplemental information: There are six subway stations in Cambridge: five Red Line stops and one Green Line stop. This layer also includes the Davis and Charles/MGH Red Line stops and the Science Park Green Line stop, which are within close walking distance of Cambridge neighborhoods.
